For each user, retain paired baseline/model hit indicators on identical candidates. Recommended analysis: bootstrap user pairs within each category, recomputing the equally weighted four-category HR@10 difference for a 95% interval; report category differences and discordant counts. Exact McNemar tests assess paired binary outcomes ([Dietterich](https://doi.org/10.1162/089976698300017197)). These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on trained models and fixed candidates, excluding training-seed and negative-sampling variability. If users overlap categories, resample by shared user identity.

Repeatedly maximizing validation scores over architectures, fusion choices and checkpoints creates selection optimism; ordinary winner-only bootstrap intervals do not correct it ([Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Prespecify one primary text-fusion contrast, checkpoint opportunities, selection rule and minimum worthwhile improvement; log every validation look. Multiplicity corrections can control a finite prespecified comparison family, but cannot remove adaptive-search bias. With splits fixed and test labels unavailable, report validation gains as exploratory and reserve confirmation for the host’s final held-out evaluation.

Suggested compute plan: compare corrected HSTU against the same backbone with jointly trained title/description fusion, one model/category, using seeds 0/42 and identical scheduled checkpoints—for example epochs 50/100/150/200, 200 batches/epoch. Profile throughput, budget complete four-category runs, and reserve debugging time within 43,200 aggregate GPU-seconds; four slots shorten elapsed time without increasing that allowance. Charge failed runs and diagnostics; report best validation versus cumulative compute ([Dodge et al.](https://aclanthology.org/D19-1224/)). Keep the pinned evaluator unchanged: HR@10 against 99 negatives measures sampled-candidate accuracy; sampled rankings can reverse full-catalog comparisons ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Treat twenty training-user full-catalog recommendations as qualitative simulator diagnostics, not independent accuracy evidence.
